name: Dumbbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and a dumbbell on the floor beside each foot, then hinge at the hips and grip them.
Brace your core and drive through your feet to stand tall, keeping your back flat.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Hinge back and lower the dumbbells to the floor under control.
image_prompt_scene: Standing over two dumbbells on the floor, hinged, gripping them.
